entities.summary: Mauno Nurmi was a professional football and ice hockey player who played in the SM-liiga. He played for TPS and TPS (football). He was inducted into the Finnish Hockey Hall of Fame in 1986. He was born in Turku, Finland. In football, he played as a forward and made five appearances for the Finland national team between 1959 and 1966.
